description: Tableau connector. Indexes Tableau dashboards and views as `tableau:dashboard` items in the local index and exposes three read-only tools (`tableau_list`, `tableau_get`, `tableau_search`) plus two HITL-gated write tools: `tableau_datasource_refresh` (trigger an extract refresh for a published datasource) and `tableau_workbook_refresh` (trigger an extract refresh for a workbook). Uses the Tableau REST API with Personal Access Token (PAT) auth. The per-tenant server URL is supplied via the `tableau.url` vault key and its hostname is added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddTableauMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty.
